paragraphs.en: The Chief Steward returned to the throne room and addressed the King: "You are foolish to waste so much time on these people." The King, enraged, shouted, awakening Billina who was sleeping under his throne. "How dare you call me a fool?"
paragraphs.zh: 首席乘务长回到宝座室，对国王说道：“你把这么多时间浪费在这些人身上真是太愚蠢了。”国王怒不可遏，大声喊道，惊醒了正躺在他脚下睡觉的比林娜。“你怎么敢说我愚蠢？”

paragraphs.en: he demanded.
paragraphs.zh: 他 demanding 地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Because I like to speak the truth," replied the Steward. "Why didn't you enchant them all at once? Instead of allowing them to enter one by one and guess which ornaments are the Queen of Ev and her children?"
paragraphs.zh: “因为我喜欢讲真话，”管家回答道，“你为什么不一次把他们都施魔法呢？为什么要让他们一个接一个地进来，猜哪件饰品是埃夫女王和她的孩子们的？”

paragraphs.en: "Why, it's more fun this way," the King retorted, "and keeps me amused for a long time."
paragraphs.zh: “这样一来反而更有趣呢，”国王反驳道，“还能让我乐上好一阵子。”

paragraphs.en: "But what if some of them guess correctly?" persisted the Steward.
paragraphs.zh: “但如果他们中有几个人猜对了怎么办？”管家坚持问道。

paragraphs.en: "There is no chance they will guess right," the King laughed. "How could they know that the Queen of Ev and her family are all royal purple ornaments?"
paragraphs.zh: “他们绝对猜不到的，”国王笑道，“谁能想到奥夫国的女王及其家人竟然全是皇家紫罗兰色的装饰品？”

paragraphs.en: "Yet there are no other purple ornaments in the palace," said the Steward. "The purple ones are scattered throughout, in many shapes and sizes."
paragraphs.zh: “然而宫殿里别处并没有其他紫色的装饰品，”管家说道，“那些紫色的东西散落在各处，形态各异。”

paragraphs.en: Billina, listening carefully under the throne, chuckled softly as she heard the King's secret revealed.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜蹲在王座下方仔细聆听，当她听到国王的秘密时轻笑了一声。

paragraphs.en: "Still, you're acting foolishly by taking this risk," the Steward continued roughly. "And it’s even more foolish to transform all those people from Oz into green ornaments."
paragraphs.zh: “尽管如此，你这么做未免太傻了，”管家粗声粗气地说，“而且把奥兹国的所有人都变成绿饰品就更加愚蠢。”

paragraphs.en: "I did that because they came from the Emerald City," replied the King. "I had no green ornaments until now. I think they will look quite pretty mixed with others, don't you?"
paragraphs.zh: “我这么做是因为它们来自翡翠城，”国王回答说，“直到现在我才没有绿色的装饰品。我觉得和其它东西混在一起会挺好看的，不是吗？”

paragraphs.en: The Steward grunted angrily.
paragraphs.zh: steward 不悦地哼了一声。

paragraphs.en: "Have your own way since you are the King," he growled. "But if you come to grief through carelessness, remember that I told you so."
paragraphs.zh: “既然你是国王，就按你自己的意思来吧，”他低吼道，“但如果你因疏忽而遭遇困境，请记住是我先说的。”

paragraphs.en: "If I wore the magic belt which enables you to work all my transformations and gives me other powers, I would make a much wiser and better King than you," the Steward added.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我戴上那条魔带，它能让你们经历我的所有变化并赋予我其他能力，我会成为一个比你明智得多、优秀得多的国王。”管家补充道。

paragraphs.en: "Cease your tiresome chatter!" commanded the King, getting angry again. "Because you are my Chief Steward, you think you can scold me as much as you please.
paragraphs.zh: “住口，你们这些烦人的唠叨！”国王又生气了，命令道，“因为你是我首席管家，就以为可以随心所欲地责备我。”

paragraphs.en: But the next time you become impudent, I will send you to work in the furnaces and get another."
paragraphs.zh: 但是你下次再敢放肆，我就把你送到熔炉里去，另寻他人。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy was instructed by the Nome King to prepare for bed early the next morning. The Steward asked about Dorothy's transformation color, which the king decided would be gray.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西被 Nome 王国的国王指示，第二天一早就要准备睡觉。管家询问多萝西变色后的颜色，而国王决定让她变成灰色。

paragraphs.en: The discussion then turned to the Scarecrow and the machine man. The king decreed they would be made of solid gold due to their unattractive appearance in real life.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，话题转向了稻草人和那台机器人的命运。国王下令，鉴于它们在现实中的外观并不吸引人，决定用纯金打造。

paragraphs.en: Billina fixed her feathers before sleeping. In the morning, Dorothy, the Lion, and Tiger were served breakfast in their rooms. The Tiger complained about being hungry and asked to become an ornament so he could eat.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜整理好羽毛后才上床睡觉。第二天一早，多萝西、狮子和老虎在各自的房间里享用早餐。老虎抱怨饿得难受，还提出想成为一件装饰品，以便能够进食。

paragraphs.en: The Nome King dismissed the Tiger's complaint, noting his recent meal. The Steward confirmed the Tiger had eaten a substantial amount but still wanted more.
paragraphs.zh: Nome王轻描淡写地驳回了老虎的抱怨，提到了他最近的一顿美餐。管家证实老虎确实吃了很多，但仍然还想多吃一些。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy requested permission to enter the palace first, but Tiktok insisted she face danger last. The Scarecrow agreed, and the machine man entered the palace.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西请求先行进入宫殿，但铁皮人坚持让她最后面对危险。稻草人同意了这一提议，于是铁皮人先进入了宫殿。

paragraphs.en: The king returned to his throne, puffing contentedly. He lamented that few remained for his fun.
paragraphs.zh: 国王回到王座上，满意地叹了口气。他感慨道，能陪他一起享乐的已经不多了。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy, trying to be brave despite her fears, entered the palace's magnificent rooms. The stillness initially awed her; she drew short breaths and pressed her hand to her heart, looking around with wonder.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西尽管心中害怕，还是努力表现得勇敢，走进了宫殿那宏伟的房间。初入这寂静的殿堂，她不禁屏住了呼吸，手按着胸口，四周的一切令她惊叹不已。

paragraphs.en: She found Tiktok standing motionless in a room. Dorothy wound him up, and he thanked her for one more guess. "Be careful," she urged, knowing the Nome King's trap.
paragraphs.zh: 她发现蒂克托克站在一间屋子里一动不动。多萝西给他上发条，他感激地对她笑了笑，表示又猜对了一次。“小心点儿，”她叮嘱道，心里明白诺曼王的陷阱绝不可大意。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok replied that they were all lost, as Smith & Tiniker hadn't given him a guessing clockwork attachment. The Scarecrow then volunteered to stay with Dorothy, saying, "Run along, little Dorothy."
paragraphs.zh: TikTok 回答说，他们全都迷路了，因为史密斯与廷基克没有给他配备猜谜钟表装置。接着稻草人主动提出要留在多萝西身边，说道：“你快去吧，小多萝西。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy entered another room, where she found Tiktok standing still. She wound him up and hurried back to the doorway.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西走进另一个房间，发现铁皮人正站在那里一动不动。她给铁皮人上紧发条，然后急忙回到了门口。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow wished her good luck as he went in. Dorothy passed through several rooms, finally finding Tiktok again. He expressed fear of their predicament, emphasizing his regret over not having a guessing clockwork.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人在他进去之前祝她好运。多萝西穿过几间房，终于又找到了铁皮人。他表达了对当前困境的担忧，强调自己要是有计时装置就好了，后悔不已。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy encouraged Tiktok to try his luck with a yellow vase adorned with daisies. Saying "Ev," Tiktok vanished in an instant. Dorothy searched every room but couldn't pinpoint which ornament had been her friend.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西鼓励蒂克托克用一个装饰着雏菊的黄色花瓶试试运气。蒂克托克脱口而出“厄”，瞬间消失无踪。多萝西搜遍了每一个房间，却无法确定是哪个装饰品不见了，那是她朋友留下的。

paragraphs.en: She accepted the task, guessing and hoping for the best. Thinking it wouldn’t hurt much, she reasoned that no one had screamed or cried out. She wondered if Uncle Henry or Aunt Em would ever know she was now a palace ornament in the Nome King’s domain.
paragraphs.zh: 她接受了这项任务，抱着侥幸的心理猜测着。她心想，这应该不会太糟糕，毕竟没有人尖叫或大声哭泣过。她好奇亨利叔叔和伊姆姨妈是否永远都不会知道，她现在成了诺姆王国内的一件宫中装饰品。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy walked through each room again, examining objects carefully but finding them too numerous to handle. She concluded it was merely guesswork with poor odds of success.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西再次走进每个房间，仔细检查着各种物品，却发现数量太多，难以一一处理。她得出结论，这纯粹是靠运气，成功的机会微乎其微。

paragraphs.en: She tentatively touched an alabaster bowl and said "Ev." Thinking this was one failure, she wondered how to identify enchanted items. Next, she approached a purple kitten statue on the mantel corner.
paragraphs.zh: 她小心翼翼地碰了碰那件象牙白的碗，轻声说道：“埃夫。”她觉得这次尝试又失败了，便思索着如何辨别魔法物品。接着，她走近壁炉角落里的一尊紫色小猫雕像。

paragraphs.en: Saying "Ev," the kitten vanished, replaced by a fair-haired boy who asked where he was.
paragraphs.zh: 说了一句“厄”，小猫突然不见了，取而代之的是一位金发少年，他好奇地问自己身在何处。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy exclaimed, “I’ve really done it.” The boy, Evring, introduced himself as a Prince of Ev and explained that there were no such things as purple kittens.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西脱口而出：“我真的闯祸了。”男孩厄文自我介绍是埃夫国的王子，并解释说根本没有紫色的小猫。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy reassured little Evring, "My father sold my mother and siblings to a cruel Nome ruler. I can't remember anything after that."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西安慰着小厄林格说：“我父亲把我母亲和兄弟姐妹卖给了一个残忍的诺姆国王。之后的事情我都记不起来了。”

paragraphs.en: "Can't be expected of a purple kitten," Dorothy said with a smile.
paragraphs.zh: “紫猫也不必做到这种地步,”多萝西微笑着说道。

paragraphs.en: "But now you're back, and I'll try to save your family members, including your mother if possible. Come with me."
paragraphs.zh: “但现在你回来了，我会尽力救出你的家人，包括你妈妈在内，如果你妈妈有机会的话。跟我来。”

paragraphs.en: She grabbed Evring's hand and hurried around, trying to choose the right object. Her third, fourth, and fifth guesses all failed.
paragraphs.zh: 她一把抓住埃弗林的手，匆匆环顾四周，试图挑选一个合适的物品。前三次、第四次和第五次猜测都失败了。

paragraphs.en: Though confused, Evring followed willingly, enjoying his new friend.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有些困惑，欧林还是欣然跟随，享受着 newfound的友谊。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy’s quest proved fruitless, but she felt joy and gratitude for saving one royal family member—Prince Evring. She could now return safely to the Nome King with her prize.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西的这次冒险并未如愿以偿，但她为救下一位王室成员——埃文宁王子而感到喜悦和感激。现在，她可以安全地带着这份收获返回 Nome 王国了。

paragraphs.en: She retraced her steps until she found the palace entrance. The massive stone doors opened automatically as she approached, allowing both Dorothy and Evring to enter the throne room.
paragraphs.zh: 她重新走回原路，终于找到了王宫的入口。随着她的靠近，那两扇巨大的石门自动开启，让多萝西和埃文格得以进入宝座室。
